entities.summary: The Port of Acre, is a marina and fishing harbor in Israel, located in the northern part of the Bay of Acre, at the southeastern corner of the Old City of Acre. The harbor was officially declared a marina in 1982 and is operated by the Old Acre Development Company via subcontractors. The marina includes five finger piers, while the area adjacent to the land quay primarily serves fishing boats.
